attempts.text:
**The window starts in a four-gene spine.** Columns 0 to 3, `gabT`, `gabD`, `lhgO` and `glaH`, are carried by 95 to 100% of chromosomes, persistent, and in a region of plasticity in 0 to 1% of calls. The model names 99% of them and hesitates no more than 0.19 bits.

**The first fork is at column 4**, an ATPase family in 66% of chromosomes, with an IS1-like element transposase and ygaR beside it. This is the most hesitant column of the window, 4.51 bits, and 59% of calls there are in a region of plasticity; column 5, ypjA, follows at 3.20 bits. The model names only 56% of calls across these two columns.

**A persistent stretch runs from `smpB` to `rplS`**, columns 6 to 19, carried by 91 to 93% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 33 to 59% of calls. The model names 67 to 83% there, fewest at `smpB`, 67%, where it hesitates 2.46 bits. Then the graph opens into fork and variable columns 20 to 79, in a region of plasticity in 12 to 32% of calls, where naming recovers to 80 to 94%.

**The variable columns carry many families at falling shares**, from yfiB at 88% and the `phe` genes near 87% down to yphE at 42%. Forks interrupt them: pssA with tapT, patZ with trxC, srmB with eamB, hmpA with yphH, and at the end yphD with yphB, then yphC with yphA. The window ends at column 79, yphC, in 39% of chromosomes.

**Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside**, 2.17 against 0.20 bits, and names fewer genes, 52% against 98%; 9,574 of 42,240 calls are inside one. Across the whole window it names 88% of genes at 0.64 bits.

label: gabT
facts:
WINDOW: the gabT window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor gabT, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,069 to 1,148 from dnaA. Read in 528 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying gabT once); 42,240 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 88% of genes, 0.64 bits on average (perplexity 2.0 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 32,447 calls, named 99%, 0.19 bits; shell 7,459 calls, named 60%, 1.76 bits; cloud 2,334 calls, named 20%, 3.33 bits. Outside an RGP 32,666 calls, named 98%, 0.20 bits; inside an RGP 9,574 calls, named 52%, 2.17 bits. Columns: 18 spine, 8 fork, 54 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (2.17 against 0.20 bits) and names fewer genes (52% against 98%); 9,574 of the 42,240 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 4 ("ATPase") 4.51 bits, RGP 59%; column 5 (ypjA) 3.20 bits, RGP 59%; column 6 (smpB) 2.46 bits, RGP 59%. The 4 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 63%, 2.95 bits on average; the other 76 columns: named 89%, 0.52 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 4-5 (fork), RGP 59%; the least: columns 0-3 (spine), RGP 0-1%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-3 (4 columns) spine: share 95-100%, all P, RGP 0-1%. Genes: gabT "aminotransferase class III-fold pyr…", gabD, lhgO, glaH. named 99%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.19 bits (column 3 (glaH)).
2. columns 4-5 (2 columns) fork: RGP 59%. named 56%; most hesitant at column 4, 4.51 bits.
   4: "ATPase" P 66%; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 28%, ygaR S 24%
   5: ypjA S 54% "autotransporter outer membrane beta…"; also ypjCB S 13%, "ParB/RepB/Spo0J family partition protein" S 11%
3. columns 6-19 (14 columns) spine: share 91-93%, all P, RGP 33-59%. Genes: smpB, ratA, yfjF "RnfH family protein", bamE, recN, nadK, grpE, yfjD "CNNM domain-containing protein", ypjD "cytochrome c biogenesis protein CcsA", ffh, rpsP, rimM, trmD, rplS. named 67-83% (mean 79%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 6 (smpB), named 67%, 2.46 bits.
4. columns 20-79 (60 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 12-32%. named 80-94% (mean 90%), fewest named at column 21, named 80%; most hesitant at column 20, 1.02 bits.
   columns 20-36 variable, share 4-88%, 16 P, 1 S: yfiB "OmpA family protein" 88%, dgcN 84%, yfiR "YfiR family protein" 85%, yfiL "DUF2799 domain-containing protein" 88%, aroF 88%, tyrA 87%, pheA 87%, pheL "pheA operon leader peptide PheL" 87%, raiA 84%, alaS 4%, insG 7%, bamD 83%, rluD 83%, yfiH "laccase domain-containing protein" 82%, clpB 82%, kgtP 79%, yfiM "YfiM family lipoprotein" 80%
   37 fork: pssA P 80%; also tapT P 79%
   38 fork: patZ P 80%; also trxC P 78%
   columns 39-43 variable, share 6-78%, 4 P, 1 S: yfiF "TrmH family RNA methyltransferase" 78%, ung 77%, grcA 77%, pinE 6%, yfiE "LysR family transcriptional regulat…" 74%
   44 fork: srmB P 76%; also eamB P 76%
   columns 45-71 variable, share 4-76%, all P: trmN 76%, nadB 75%, rseD 75%, rpoE 74%, rseA 73%, rseB "sigma-E factor regulatory protein R…" 72%, rseC 72%, lepA "translation elongation factor 4" 71%, lepB 71%, rnc 70%, era 70%, recO 69%, pdxJ 67%, acpS 66%, shoB 64%, yfhL "4Fe-4S dicluster ferredoxin YfhL" 62%, yfhH "MurR/RpiR family transcriptional re…" 59%, hypE 4%, flhA 4%, yfhb "phosphatidylglycerophosphatase C" 59%, tadA 59%, mltF 58%, purL 57%, qseE "two component system sensor histidi…" 55%, qseG 54%, glrR 52%, glnB 51%
   72 fork: hmpA P 50%; also yphH P 48%
   columns 73-77 variable, share 3-50%, all P: glyA 50%, rpoS 3%, yphG "DUF5107 domain-containing protein" 47%, yphF "substrate-binding domain-containing…" 44%, yphE "sugar ABC transporter ATP-binding p…" 42%
   78 fork: yphD P 43% "ABC transporter permease"; also yphB P 29%
   79 fork: yphC P 39% "alcohol dehydrogenase catalytic dom…"; also yphA P 21%
PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): gabD aldehyde dehydrogenase family protein; pheA chorismate mutase; rseA anti-sigma-E factor RseA; rseC SoxR-reducing system protein RseC; lepB signal peptidase I; qseG two-component system QseEF-associated l…; tapT tRNA-uridine aminocarboxypropyltransfer…; trxC thioredoxin TrxC; eamB cysteine/O-acetylserine transporter; yphB aldose 1-epimerase
END: the window ends at column 79, yphC, in 39% of chromosomes.
